note: Spring 2026, the first term after the return to trimesters; every programme except Law. Its summary payment table garbles the final-installment row ("01 April - 15 April 2026 / 05 April - 19 April 2026"); the main table's 1-16 April is used. Club, wellbeing, census, parents', sports and research-showcase weeks and staff deadlines are left out. classes-pause is the last class before the mid-term, not the end of teaching.
